title: President Trump awards Big Tech donors with nation’s highest science prizes
summary: President Trump awarded prominent tech leaders Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Sergey Brin, and Lisa Su the National Medal of Science, the nation's highest science honor. The awards recognize their contributions to scientific advancement in the technology sector.
content: On Thursday, President Trump awarded Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Sergey Brin, and AMD’s Lisa Su the National Medal of Science, the nation’s top science prize.

title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
summary: Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, a free service providing automated security vulnerability scanning for open-source projects using its advanced AI models. The fully model-generated reports offer faster and more frequent scans but lack human review, potentially resulting in false positives.
content:
Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner. It says open-source projects that opt-in will get "thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost." That could mean open-source projects get alerted about possible security issues sooner, but the trade-off is that OSS Scanner's reports don't come with human review:
The outputs of this opt-in vulnerability scanner will be fully model-generated, without human review or triage. This will enable faster and more frequent scanning, but means that it is possible reports will be incorrect or invalid. Th …

title: SpaceX announces plan to become a ‘major mobile carrier’
summary: SpaceX has acquired low-band spectrum licenses as part of its plan to establish Starlink Mobile as a major U.S. mobile carrier, combining satellite and terrestrial networks. The 800 MHz spectrum will enable signal penetration through buildings, directly competing with T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon.
content:
SpaceX has acquired a portfolio of low-band spectrum licenses - a move the company says "will pave the way" for its Starlink Mobile service to become a "major" US carrier. When the Federal Communications Commission signs off on the deal, SpaceX says it will deploy its new architecture that combines its satellite-to-mobile constellation with a terrestrial mobile network, directly competing with T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon.
The licenses include up to 14 megahertz of paired spectrum in the 800 MHz band, which SpaceX says will allow Starlink Mobile's signal to penetrate through walls and buildings. SpaceX previously acquired 2GHz spectrum from  …

title: AMD will bring FSR 4 to handhelds by the end of 2026
summary: AMD has committed to bringing its framerate-enhancing FSR 4 technology to handhelds by the end of 2026, though it remains unclear if existing devices like the Steam Deck will receive it. The rollout will coincide with a new AMD chip designed to support FSR4 capabilities.
content:
It's already possible to get AMD's framerate-enhancing FSR 4 boost on handhelds as old as the Steam Deck - but in June, AMD reserved the right to disappoint handheld gamers by not officially bringing FSR 4 to older handhelds. Now, AMD consumer chip boss Jack Huynh says he will bring the tech to some handhelds by the end of the year.
Which handhelds? It's still not clear if it will come to existing handhelds, or if you'll need a new one to get it - because it comes alongside news that AMD is releasing a new FSR4-capable chip.
"We will expand the machine learning AI-based FSR4 technology, which was first introduced to existing external graph …

title: California is trying to shut down robot vs. human cage matches

The regulatory action highlights the legal gray area surrounding robot fighting events.
content:
The California State Athletic Commission sent a cease-and-desist letter to a startup that hosted a match between a human and a robot last month, as reported by The New York Times.
The fight, which took place on September 18th, pitted a human, Frankie LaPenna, against a humanoid robot owned by a tech startup, Rek, that was being piloted by a human using what the NYT described as a "remote virtual-reality system." Rek says it is the "the humanoid robot fighting league" on its website, and the robot appears to be one from EngineAI but with a Terminator-like head swapped on top.

title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect

title: Let's Encrypt cuts certificate lifetimes to 64 days starting February 2027
summary: Let's Encrypt will reduce SSL/TLS certificate lifetimes from 90 days to 64 days beginning in February 2027. The shorter validity periods aim to encourage automation and reduce the risk of security issues persisting in long-lived certificates.
content: Free SSL/TLS certificate lifetimes reduce to 64 days in February.

title: ICE detainees in Georgia used the facility’s video calling software to expose the conditions inside
summary: Four men detained at the Folkston ICE Processing Center in Georgia used the facility's video conferencing system to expose conditions inside and what they describe as an intentionally dysfunctional legal system. The activists documented concerns about indefinite detention in privately owned facilities that profit from detainee confinement.
content:
Detainees are seen in a yard at the Folkston ICE Processing Center on September 9, 2025, in Folkston, Georgia. (Photo by ELIJAH NOUVELAGE/AFP via Getty Images) | AFP via Getty Images	

Four men detained at an ICE detention center in rural Georgia used the facility's video conferencing software to expose both the conditions inside and President Donald Trump's hostile takeover of the immigration courts. In the five-minute video, the men describe an intentionally dysfunctional legal system designed to keep them trapped in federal custody for months or years - in privately owned facilities that profit from their confinement.

Windows Search has been one of the most frustrating parts of Windows 11, and now Microsoft is addressing this with a significant overhaul. A new redesigned Windows Search is now in testing that is much faster, more capable, and a lot more modern.
"This new Windows Search experience is built for speed," says Anshul Rawat, corporate vice president of the Windows product team at Microsoft. "It's built on WinUI 3 and is part of our broader investment in modernizing our core Windows experiences."

Jack Black in A Minecraft Movie. | Image: Warner Bros.

title: Cupertino might be made for your mom, but it’s a good take on tech
summary: CBS launches drama series Cupertino that uses contemporary tech controversies as storytelling backdrop, translating tech industry backlash into broadcast television drama.
content:
Ella Stiller, Mike Colter, and Rachel Keller star in Cupertino. | CBS	

Cupertino brings the tech backlash to the CBS procedural - an initially awkward combination, but with rewarding results. The show starts off just slightly unsure, but quickly figures out what to do with these strange times, creating fictionalized dupes of the Zizians, Polymarket, Jeff Bezos' looksmaxxing obsession, OpenAI stealing Scarlett Johansson's voice, and the fight for AI guardrails, among other familiar tales, and using them to speak to the feeling of helplessness in the face of rapid change that extends well beyond the greater San Francisco area.
